title: Form the pouring spout of an unsealed gable carton
instruction: Unfold the inward-folded pouring spout of the already unsealed carton. Leave a mouth at least 30 mm wide, with the pouring tip and its upper lip at least 8 mm beyond the front wall. Leave the carton upright on the table, released and stable for at least three seconds.
context: Before pouring milk or juice from a cap-free gable carton, its inward-folded paper spout must be unfolded. This everyday package-opening operation starts after the outer seal has been separated and ends before pouring.
setup: One free custom gable carton: lined paperboard nominal350g/m2,0.45mm;70x70mm pitch,110mm body,35mm roof rise,12mm outer and24mm inner fins. Stationary body/contents520g;total522.701g.
